description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports Control Regulations on payment Terms No. 09 of 2022 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically the "Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 09 of 2022." It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations and authorization for issuing operating instructions. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities but rather on the regulatory content itself, making it primarily a legal/regulatory gazette.
